note: The office pattern of generated/office-variations-20261112/generate.py: a lobby at one end (the only way in from outside), a corridor the length of the plan with private offices, conference rooms, restrooms, a pantry and sometimes focus rooms off it, and an open office at the far end. Every rule is exploratory: the pattern is a generator's, not a traced plan's. Double-swing doors count as swing here.

rules.name: kinds-known
rules.subject: every space
rules.rationale: Counts, areas and connections are judged by kind, so a space of no known kind is judged by nothing.

rules.name: edges-name-spaces
rules.subject: every edge that is not to the exterior
rules.rationale: An edge to nothing is a graph that was not read right.
exceptions: an edge marked exterior goes outside and is skipped

rules.name: kind-counts
rules.subject: each kind
rules.rationale: One lobby, one corridor and one open office; at least one private office, conference room, restroom and pantry; focus rooms are optional.

rules.name: kind-areas
rules.subject: each space
rules.predicate: has an area in square metres
rules.rationale: The ranges hold the rooms the pattern's bands make in plans of 150 to 600 m2.

rules.name: connections-by-means
rules.subject: each door or open edge
rules.predicate: joins a pair of kinds by a means
rules.rationale: Every link is a swing door (or a double-swing one) from the corridor, but the lobby's, which the corridor also has.

rules.name: one-exterior-door-on-lobby
rules.subject: the doors to the outside
rules.rationale: The lobby is the pattern's only way in from outside.

rules.name: entry-is-lobby
rules.subject: the entry
rules.rationale: The plan is entered through its lobby.

rules.name: lobby-joins-corridor
rules.subject: the lobby
rules.rationale: The corridor starts at the lobby.

rules.name: side-rooms-door-to-corridor
rules.subject: a private office, conference room, restroom, pantry or focus room
rules.rationale: The rooms of the pattern open off the corridor, never off each other or the open office.

rules.name: private-office-door-to-corridor
rules.subject: a private office
rules.rationale: A private office is reached by a door, not an open link, from the corridor.

rules.name: open-office-at-the-corridor-end
rules.subject: the open office
rules.object: the corridor, not the lobby, and no side room opens off it
rules.rationale: The open office is the far end of the corridor; the lobby is the near one.

rules.name: all-reached-from-entry
rules.subject: every space
rules.rationale: A space nobody can reach is no plan.
